Illumination.note: Resource loop: heal crits refund mana, so spell crit is also mana regen for a Holy paladin.

Holy Power.note: Bigger crits also mean bigger Illumination refunds are worth chasing with crit.

Infusion of Light.note: Proc chain: Holy Shock or Flash of Light crit → faster next Holy Light.

Boundless Light.note: Crit bonus for Holy Shock on allies outside your Oath of Light, which feeds Illumination and Infusion of Light.

Oath of Light.note: Single-target focus: stronger heals on one sworn ally (usually the tank).

Vengeance.note: Proc chain: crits stack Vengeance (up to 5) → more Physical and Holy damage. Keeps up best with high crit (Conviction).

Conviction.note: More crits keep Vengeance stacked and feed Illumination.

Reckoning.note: Proc chain: block or being crit → extra swings (up to 4 stored).

Redoubt.note: Proc: being hit → more block for 5 blocks; pairs with Holy Shield and Reckoning.

Holy Shield.note: Every block deals Holy damage with extra threat; more block (Redoubt) means more damage and Reckoning procs.

Sanctified Judgement.note: Resource loop: Judgement returns most of the seal's mana cost.
